name: v28-40-living-divergence-prefetch
objective: Plan 22 plumbing through LivingPort with scripted judge readings and a scripted director draft (storyOrchestratorDebugLivingResponse): PLUMBING ONLY, no model quality claim. Judge-off control: a committed turn reads nothing and places no branch job. Divergence: two player turns read as off-route (none p 0.85, commits 0.9) give streak 1 then 2, the second places living:branch:start; a reply with no new player line is the same turn and asks nothing; the auto branch liv_b1_way applies at the next boundary with source -> stub -> anchor transitions, and the checkpoint is then not read again (one branch per checkpoint). Prefetch: at the next anchor with preparing ahead on and the judge silent, a boundary places living:prefetch:goal, the prepared branch liv_b2_way applies at the following boundary; with preparing ahead off nothing more is prepared. Sequential turns only: the concurrent same-turn double count (fixed on v2.8-review-fixes) is not exercised here.

requires.why: Director and judge answers are scripted in the page; this proves wiring, not model behaviour.

steps.eval: const s = globalThis.storyOrchestratorRuntime.getGlobalSettings(); if (s.image.enabled || s.sprites.enabled) throw new Error('media must be off'); globalThis.storyOrchestratorDebugExtractionResponse = 'SCENE_NONE'; globalThis.storyOrchestratorDebugLivingResponse = JSON.stringify({ name: 'The cliff path', objective: 'Climb the cliff path the player chose and rejoin the road above.', tension: 'stirring', snapshot: {}, opens_when: { new: { key: 'cliff', rubric: 'Has the player started up the cliff?' } }, new_qualities: [], builds_on: null, new_chapter: false, final: false, reason: 'synthetic divergence plumbing' }); return { mediaOff: true };

checkpoints.name: The Road
checkpoints.objective: Follow the road to the inn.

steps.eval: const rt = globalThis.storyOrchestratorRuntime; rt.setStagecraftSettings({ livingEnabled: true, branchingEnabled: true, prefetchEnabled: false }); const judge = rt.getJudge(); globalThis.__l40 = { judge, active: judge.active, ask: judge.ask, calls: [], reading: null, state: () => rt.extras.living, sleep: (ms) => new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, ms)), jobs: () => (rt.getSnapshot().scheduler?.recent ?? []).map((j) => j.reason ?? j) }; judge.active = (use) => globalThis.__l40.reading !== null && use === 'divergence'; globalThis.__l40.other = []; judge.ask = async (use, request) => { if (use !== 'divergence') { globalThis.__l40.other.push(use); return { answers: null, fallback: 'disabled', latencyMs: 0, cached: false }; } globalThis.__l40.calls.push({ use, questions: Object.keys(request.questions) }); return { answers: globalThis.__l40.reading, latencyMs: 0, cached: false }; }; return { stubbed: true, divergenceActive: judge.active('divergence') };

steps.send: I leave the road and look up at the cliff.

steps.slash: /sendas name="DM Narrator" raw=false The road bends away below the cliff.

steps.eval: const b = globalThis.__l40; const d = b.state()?.divergence; if (b.calls.length) throw new Error('judge-off control asked the judge'); if (d?.last) throw new Error('judge-off control wrote a reading: ' + JSON.stringify(d)); if ((b.state()?.proposals ?? []).length) throw new Error('judge-off control proposed a branch'); b.reading = { fit: { type: 'choice', choice: 'none', confidence: 0.85, probabilities: { none: 0.85, exit_1: 0.15 } }, commits: { type: 'noul', noul: 0.9 } }; return { control: 'no reading, no job', divergence: d ?? null };

steps.send: I start climbing the cliff instead of going to the inn.

steps.slash: /sendas name="DM Narrator" raw=false Loose stones skitter down as you climb.

steps.eval: const b = globalThis.__l40; const d = b.state().divergence; if (b.calls.length !== 1 || b.calls[0].use !== 'divergence') throw new Error('expected one divergence read: ' + JSON.stringify(b.calls)); if (d.streak !== 1 || d.checkpointId !== 'start' || !d.last || d.last.none !== true) throw new Error('streak not 1 after one off-route turn: ' + JSON.stringify(d)); if ((b.state().proposals ?? []).length) throw new Error('branched after one reading'); b.firstTurn = d.lastTurn; return { streak: d.streak, last: d.last };

const b = globalThis.__l40; const d = b.state().divergence; if (b.calls.length !== 1) throw new Error('a reply with no new player line was read again: ' + b.calls.length); if (d.streak !== 1 || d.lastTurn !== b.firstTurn) throw new Error('same turn moved the streak: ' + JSON.stringify(d)); return { sameTurn: 'skipped', streak: d.streak };

steps.send: I keep climbing toward the top of the cliff.

steps.slash: /sendas name="DM Narrator" raw=false The wind picks up near the ledge.

steps.eval: const b = globalThis.__l40; const until = Date.now() + 10000; while (!(b.state().proposals ?? []).some((p) => p.kind === 'branch') && Date.now() < until) await b.sleep(100); const d = b.state().divergence; const branch = (b.state().proposals ?? []).find((p) => p.kind === 'branch'); if (b.calls.length !== 2) throw new Error('expected two reads: ' + b.calls.length); if (!branch) throw new Error('second off-route turn did not propose a branch: ' + JSON.stringify(d)); if (branch.prepared) throw new Error('divergence branch marked prepared'); if (!(d.branchedFrom ?? []).includes('start')) throw new Error('checkpoint not marked branched: ' + JSON.stringify(d)); if (branch.status !== 'accepted') throw new Error('player branch should be auto-accepted: ' + branch.status); b.branch = branch.id; return { streak: d.streak, branch: { id: branch.id, status: branch.status, why: branch.why, convergeTo: branch.convergeTo } };

steps.send: I reach the top of the cliff.

steps.slash: /sendas name="DM Narrator" raw=false A narrow path runs along the clifftop.

steps.eval: const rt = globalThis.storyOrchestratorRuntime; const b = globalThis.__l40; const until = Date.now() + 10000; while (!rt.getStory()?.checkpointById?.liv_b1_way && Date.now() < until) await b.sleep(100); const story = rt.getStory(); const way = story.checkpointById.liv_b1_way; if (!way) throw new Error('branch stub not applied: ' + JSON.stringify(b.state().proposals.map((p) => [p.id, p.status]))); const edges = story.transitions.filter((t) => t.from === 'start' && t.to === 'liv_b1_way').length + story.transitions.filter((t) => t.from === 'liv_b1_way' && t.to === 'goal').length; if (edges !== 2) throw new Error('branch edges wrong: ' + JSON.stringify(story.transitions.map((t) => t.from + '>' + t.to))); if (!b.state().proposals.some((p) => p.id === b.branch && p.status === 'applied')) throw new Error('branch proposal not applied'); if (b.calls.length !== 2) throw new Error('checkpoint read again after its branch: ' + b.calls.length); b.reading = null; return { stub: 'liv_b1_way', edges, reads: b.calls.length };

steps.send: We arrive at the inn and sit down.

steps.slash: /sendas name="DM Narrator" raw=false The innkeeper nods at you.

steps.eval: const b = globalThis.__l40; const until = Date.now() + 10000; const prepared = () => (b.state().proposals ?? []).find((p) => p.kind === 'branch' && p.prepared); while (!prepared() && Date.now() < until) await b.sleep(100); const p = prepared(); if (!p) throw new Error('no prepared branch at the inn: ' + JSON.stringify(b.state().proposals.map((x) => [x.id, x.kind, x.prepared, x.status]))); if (b.calls.length !== 2) throw new Error('prefetch asked the judge'); if (!/prepared ahead/i.test(p.why ?? '')) throw new Error('prepared why wrong: ' + p.why); if (!(b.state().divergence.branchedFrom ?? []).includes('goal')) throw new Error('prefetch did not use up the checkpoint branch'); b.prepared = p.id; return { prepared: p.id, status: p.status, why: p.why };

steps.slash: /sendas name="Arin" raw=false I will get us a table.

steps.eval: const rt = globalThis.storyOrchestratorRuntime; const b = globalThis.__l40; const until = Date.now() + 10000; while (!rt.getStory()?.checkpointById?.liv_b2_way && Date.now() < until) await b.sleep(100); const story = rt.getStory(); if (!story.checkpointById.liv_b2_way) throw new Error('prepared branch not applied'); if (!story.transitions.some((t) => t.from === 'goal' && t.to === 'liv_b2_way') || !story.transitions.some((t) => t.from === 'liv_b2_way' && t.to === 'end')) throw new Error('prepared branch edges wrong'); rt.setStagecraftSettings({ prefetchEnabled: false }); b.branchCount = b.state().proposals.filter((p) => p.kind === 'branch').length; return { stub: 'liv_b2_way', branches: b.branchCount };

steps.slash: /sendas name="DM Narrator" raw=false The fire crackles.
